c74object.name: sunny.clock~
c74object.digest: Generate Sunny local quarter-note position as a signal
c74object.description: Generate one mono signal containing the local clock position in quarter notes at the start of each sample. This object is not a Max transport or Ableton Live song-position observer. Message controls are serialized outside the audio callback and take effect in order at the next valid signal-vector boundary.

objarg.name: ppq
objarg.digest: Set local pulses per quarter note in the range 1 to 65535

method.name: tempo
method.description: Accept a finite value in the range 20 to 999 BPM.

method.name: position
method.digest: Seek the local integer tick position
method.description: Accept a nonnegative tick and clear the retained fractional tick.

method.name: record
method.description: Recording advances the local clock but does not capture MIDI or audio.

method.name: pause
method.digest: Pause and retain the exact local position

method.name: stop
method.digest: Stop and reset the local position to zero

method.name: status
method.description: Post configuration, setup, control, current pending-control, process, and last-error evidence to the Max console. The right message outlet also emits the closed tuple `host_status configured sample_rate maximum_frames process_observed process_calls last_frame_count process_healthy last_error`; `process_calls` is an exact signed saturating callback count and the left outlet remains the sole signal outlet.

method.name: clear_error
method.description: Clear the last-error code without clearing counters or clock state.
